name: gitlab-tools
description: GitLab MCP server (merge requests, pipelines, issues). Install it when your team's code lives on GitLab (gitlab.com or self-managed). Merges, deployments and production pipelines are blocked by the core guard.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab personal access token
gitlab_token.description: Your own token with the api scope (Developer on the team repos is enough; never Maintainer for an agent).
